name: Rear Guard Patrol
summary: In Tirisfal Glades, Deathguard Linnea calls the patrollers to defend the border. She sends them after Riptear, an abomination roaming near Venomweb Vale that should never have passed the Bulwark.

sections.title: The Breach at the Border
sections.body: The Bulwark is the only fortified barrier between Tirisfal Glades and the horrors of the Western Plaguelands. Forsaken strategy depends on holding one front. If mindless undead slip behind the lines, they can choke the supply routes that feed it. Spirits and ghouls sometimes get past the barricades, but an abomination roaming the glades means containment has failed badly.

sections.title: The Threat of Riptear
sections.body: Riptear, a rogue abomination, was sighted near Venomweb Vale. Abominations are huge engines of slaughter, stitched from corpses by dark necromancy. Such a creature cannot cross fortified chokepoints unseen, and its presence leaves Deathguard Linnea deeply unsettled. She demands Riptear's heart as proof the creature has been destroyed.

faq.q: Who offers the Rear Guard Patrol quest?
faq.answer: Deathguard Linnea, a Forsaken Deathguard in Tirisfal Glades, issues the patrol order and reports to Executor Zygand.
Riptear is a rogue abomination roaming the eastern glades near Venomweb Vale, behind the forward defensive lines.

faq.q: Why is an abomination near Venomweb Vale so alarming?
aliases: why is riptear a big deal
why is an abomination dangerous here
faq.answer: Abominations require dark necromancy and heavy labor to create. One slipping unnoticed through the heavily fortified Bulwark points to a grave breach or an unseen path behind Forsaken lines.

faq.q: Where is the beast usually found?
faq.answer: Riptear has been sighted in the woods and clearings of eastern Tirisfal Glades near Venomweb Vale.

faq.q: What proof is required to finish the patrol?
faq.answer: Deathguard Linnea requires Riptear's Heart as proof that the massive abomination has been destroyed for good.

faq.q: Who oversees the defense of the Bulwark?
aliases: who is in charge of bulwark
faq.answer: The Bulwark's commander is not named. Deathguard Linnea answers to Executor Zygand in Brill, who receives her commendations for patrols that keep the Scourge at bay.

angles.text: Securing Tirisfal's eastern border protects the supply lines to the Bulwark and the Undercity from rogue horrors.
As an undead, you know the Forsaken cannot fight on two fronts. Any Scourge construct roaming behind their barricades threatens the kingdom's survival.

attribution: In-game quest text: Rear Guard Patrol
